metadata.description:
The stars on the black exterior, the pulsing beats inside—First Ave is a sacred space in the Minneapolis music scene. Prince made it legendary, but generations of performers have made it home. Whether you caught a live show or just stood in awe at the door, this place radiates cool. Claim this Culture Collector POAP and let everyone know you visited a cultural cathedral of the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Culture Collector 
GPS: 44.97853, -93.27599 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97853,-93.27599
